name: CJPL-I

summary.plain: The original hall of the China Jinping Underground Laboratory, reached from a hydropower station tunnel under more than two kilometres of mountain rock in Sichuan, China.
summary.technical: CJPL-I: the original CJPL hall beside the Jinping traffic tunnel, Sichuan, inaugurated 2010, with ~2400 m (2400 m.w.e.) rock overburden, among the deepest overburdens of any underground laboratory in the world.
